metas.name: The Remarried Empress
metas.description: Beloved Empress Navier rules the Eastern Empire alongside Emperor Sovieshu. But when Sovieshu falls for a runaway slave and demands a divorce, Navier will agree on one condition: that she's given approval to remarry rival Prince Heinrey of the Western Kingdom.

metas.name: Black Doves
metas.description: When a spy posing as a politician's wife learns her lover has been murdered, an old assassin friend joins her on a quest for truth — and vengeance.

metas.name: VisionQuest
metas.description: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

metas.name: Dead-End Job
metas.description: Drowning in debt, a young man takes lucrative part-time jobs from a mysterious agency — only to find his hustle for more money turning nightmarish.

metas.name: MobLand
metas.description: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

metas.name: Dexter: Resurrection
metas.description: Set 10 weeks after Dexter: New Blood, Dexter Morgan chases a missing Harrison to New York City, where Captain Angel Batista is hot on their trail from way down in Miami.

metas.name: Lupin
metas.description: Inspired by the adventures of Arsène Lupin, gentleman thief Assane Diop sets out to avenge his father for an injustice inflicted by a wealthy family.

metas.name: The Greatest
metas.description: Fresh off gold at the 1960 Olympics, young boxer Muhammad Ali (then known as Cassius Clay) sets his sights on the Heavyweight Championship. Contending with newfound fame, self-doubt, family conflict and a politically charged America, the once-in-a-generation prodigy discovers his greatest opponent won't be in the ring, but in a society that isn't ready for him to become his own man.

metas.name: Nocturne
metas.description: When a victim of notorious serial killer Jurek Walter unexpectedly turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn races against time to find the one person still missing, while his protégé Saga Bauer goes undercover to get answers from the killer himself.

metas.name: Campus Drivers
metas.description: Lois arrives in Belrose with Max, the love of her life. Lane, the creator of Campus Drivers, the hottest app on campus, is known for never getting attached. Their paths were never meant to cross. But some encounters change everything, reopening old wounds. And when love appears unexpectedly, nothing is certain anymore.
